meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 在已有的人物访谈或播客视频上添加与说话内容同步的图形卡片，如动态标题、信息条、数据引用、画中画；Claude 设计卡片时间与内容，生成带卡片的 MP4，原画面不动。
howto.when: 当用户为已有谈话/播客视频提出图形包装需求，例如说 'graphic overlays'、'on-screen graphics' 或 'package / dress up my video' 时触发；纯字幕需求不在本技能范围。

say.text: 给这段访谈视频加上和语音同步的动态标题和数据卡片，原画面别改。
say.note: Claude 会设计卡片并按时间渲染为带卡片的 MP4。

say.text: 在这段播客里，当他说到“市场风险”时弹出一句引文。
say.note: 引文卡片恰好出现在那个时间点。

say.text: 帮我给这个演讲视频加上底部信息条和侧边栏数据。
say.note: 按内容节奏布置多种图形卡片。

howto.what_en: Adds timed graphic cards to an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video, synced to the speech. Claude designs the cards and renders an MP4, leaving the original clip intact.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'graphic overlays', 'on-screen graphics', or 'package / dress up my video' for an existing talking-head clip. Plain subtitles are not covered.

say_en.text: Add animated titles and data cards to this interview video.
say_en.note: Renders an MP4 with animated cards.

say_en.text: Pop a quote card when he says 'market risk' in this podcast clip.
say_en.note: Card appears right at that moment.

say_en.text: Add lower-thirds and a side panel to this talk video.
say_en.note: Applies graphic overlays synced to the speech.
